questions.answer: Fit with the actual task, access and safety requirements.
To communicate relevant experience and limits accurately.

questions.prompt: What if a requirement is unclear?
questions.answer: Verify it with the responsible organiser or request an appropriate alternative.
questions.feedback: Do not invent a dress code.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Designs functional, truthful and accessible presentation without irrelevant appearance or status judgments.
scoring.transfer: Create a fictional presentation readiness checklist for two different settings. Include task requirements, factual introduction, materials, accessibility and an uncertainty or contingency. Explain which criteria assess function and which merely reflect impressions.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
